selection_rule: Protocol constants and existing E0 defaults fixed globally without holdout access; no family-specific or scale-specific tuning.

information_access.shared_by_A_to_E: static topology and edge delta/base resistance, local actions, and own observed outcomes
information_access.A_HIST_note: Receives the shared representation but performs no lookahead.

shared.override_rule: Override historized/revisit greedy only on disagreement, confidence >= 0.85, path-count imbalance <= 3.0, and no path-cap hit.
shared.path_cap_rule: Stop the episode decision, mark path_cap_hit, and assign primary score 0.0.
shared.failure_rule: FAILURE consumes one interaction, leaves position at source, and is inscribed in historization.

A_HIST.implementation: Historized effective-tension greedy with multiplicative recent-state penalty.

B_INCOHERENT.implementation: Non-coherent sum of per-path intensities over the common bounded path family.

C_THETA_ZERO.implementation: Coherent positive-real path mass over the common bounded path family.

D_U1_PHASE.implementation: Manual U(1) superposition using structural_geometry.theta over the common bounded path family.

E_FULL_GEOMETRY.implementation: Direct lean.structural_geometry.influence_map call; returned paths are checked against the B-D family.

primary_control_selection.status: pending WP-2.4 development raw-data execution and preregistered selection rule; must be frozen before holdout
